Scenario / Description: Verify login with valid credentials
Test Steps:
1. Open SauceDemo URL.
2. Enter username 'standard_user'.
3. Enter password 'secret_sauce'.
4. Click 'Login'.
Expected Result: User is successfully authenticated and redirected to the product inventory page (/inventory.html).

Scenario / Description: Verify login attempt with a locked-out user account
Test Steps:
1. Open SauceDemo URL.
2. Enter username 'locked_out_user'.
3. Enter password 'secret_sauce'.
4. Click 'Login'.
Expected Result: Login is blocked and error message displays: 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.'

Scenario / Description: Verify login attempt with blank username and password
Test Steps:
1. Open SauceDemo URL.
2. Leave Username and Password fields empty.
3. Click 'Login'.
Expected Result: Login fails and error message displays: 'Epic sadface: Username is required'.

Scenario / Description: Verify login attempt with valid username and incorrect password
Test Steps:

2. Enter username 'standard_user'.
3. Enter password 'invalid_pass'.
4. Click 'Login'.
Expected Result: Login fails and error message displays: 'Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service'.

Scenario / Description: Verify user login with high-latency user account (performance_glitch_user)

2. Enter username 'performance_glitch_user'.
3. Enter password 'secret_sauce'.
4. Click 'Login'.
Expected Result: User lands on inventory page after a minor loading delay without crash or failure.

Scenario / Description: Verify error state user login behavior (error_user)

2. Enter username 'error_user'.
3. Enter password 'secret_sauce'.
4. Click 'Login'.
Expected Result: User logs in successfully to inventory page; specific unexpected component behaviors can be monitored.

Scenario / Description: Verify layout and display of all inventory items upon page load
Test Steps:
1. Log in as 'standard_user'.
2. Observe the inventory grid on /inventory.html.
Expected Result: All 6 products are displayed with valid images, titles, descriptions, prices, and 'Add to cart' buttons.

Scenario / Description: Verify product list sorting by Name (A to Z)
Test Steps:
1. Click on product sort dropdown.
2. Select 'Name (A to Z)'.
Expected Result: Products dynamically re-order alphabetically in ascending order from A to Z.

Scenario / Description: Verify product list sorting by Name (Z to A)
Test Steps:
1. Click on product sort dropdown.
2. Select 'Name (Z to A)'.
Expected Result: Products dynamically re-order alphabetically in descending order from Z to A.

Scenario / Description: Verify product list sorting by Price (low to high)
Test Steps:
1. Click on product sort dropdown.
2. Select 'Price (low to high)'.
Expected Result: Products re-order based on price starting from lowest ($7.99) to highest ($49.99).

Scenario / Description: Verify product list sorting by Price (high to low)
Test Steps:
1. Click on product sort dropdown.
2. Select 'Price (high to low)'.
Expected Result: Products re-order based on price starting from highest ($49.99) to lowest ($7.99).

Scenario / Description: Verify clicking product title opens Product Details page
Test Steps: 1. On catalog page, click on 'Sauce Labs Backpack' title link.
Expected Result: Navigation redirects to /inventory-item.html showing enlarged image, full description, price, and 'Back to products' button.

Scenario / Description: Verify adding item to cart directly from Product Details page
Test Steps:
1. Navigate to product details page for 'Sauce Labs Backpack'.
2. Click 'Add to cart'.
Expected Result: Button label changes to 'Remove', and shopping cart badge counter increases to 1.

Scenario / Description: Verify adding multiple products to cart updates badge count dynamically
Test Steps:
1. Click 'Add to cart' on Sauce Labs Backpack.
2. Click 'Add to cart' on Sauce Labs Bike Light.
Expected Result: Cart badge icon at top right updates count to display '2'.

Scenario / Description: Verify removing an item from cart updates badge count
Test Steps:
1. Add 2 items to cart.
2. Click 'Remove' button on one item.
Expected Result: Selected item is removed, button reverts to 'Add to cart', and cart badge count decreases to '1'.

Scenario / Description: Verify navigating to Cart page displays accurate selected items
Test Steps:
1. Add 'Sauce Labs Backpack' to cart.
2. Click shopping cart icon.
Expected Result: Cart page (/cart.html) opens displaying item title, quantity (1), and price ($29.99).

Scenario / Description: Verify 'Continue Shopping' button functionality in Cart page
Test Steps: 1. From Cart page, click 'Continue Shopping' button.
Expected Result: User is redirected back to product inventory catalog page (/inventory.html) retaining added items.

Scenario / Description: Verify successful navigation to Checkout Step One page
Test Steps: 1. In Cart page with items added, click 'Checkout' button.
Expected Result: User lands on Checkout: Your Information page (/checkout-step-one.html).

Scenario / Description: Verify checkout progression with valid customer details
Test Steps:
1. Fill First Name: 'Vikas'.
2. Fill Last Name: 'Kumar'.
3. Fill Zip/Postal Code: '560001'.
4. Click 'Continue'.
Expected Result: Information is submitted successfully and user advances to Checkout Step Two (/checkout-step-two.html).

Scenario / Description: Verify checkout validation error when mandatory field (Zip Code) is missing
Test Steps:
1. Fill First Name: 'Vikas'.
2. Fill Last Name: 'Kumar'.
3. Leave Zip/Postal Code empty.
4. Click 'Continue'.
Expected Result: System blocks submission and displays error message: 'Error: Postal Code is required'.

Scenario / Description: Verify 'Cancel' button on Checkout Step One returns to Cart page
Test Steps: 1. On Checkout Step One page, click 'Cancel' button.
Expected Result: User is redirected back to Cart page (/cart.html) with cart contents intact.

Scenario / Description: Verify Checkout Overview displays correct product details, price calculation, and tax
Test Steps:
1. Add 'Sauce Labs Backpack' ($29.99) and 'Sauce Labs Bike Light' ($9.99) to cart.
2. Proceed through Checkout Step 1.
3. Inspect Checkout Overview page.
Expected Result: Overview page lists both items, Item Total ($39.98), calculated Tax ($3.20), and Total Price ($43.18) accurately.

Scenario / Description: Verify 'Cancel' button on Checkout Overview page cancels transaction
Test Steps: 1. On Checkout Step Two page, click 'Cancel' button.
Expected Result: Transaction is aborted and user is redirected back to Product Catalog page (/inventory.html).

Scenario / Description: Verify order completion and confirmation screen display
Test Steps: 1. On Checkout Overview page, click 'Finish' button.
Expected Result: Order is placed successfully; redirected to /checkout-complete.html showing 'Thank you for your order!' and dispatch message.

Scenario / Description: Verify 'Back Home' button resets cart state after order completion
Test Steps: 1. On Checkout Complete page, click 'Back Home' button.
Expected Result: User is redirected to inventory page; shopping cart badge counter is cleared and reset to 0.

Scenario / Description: Verify 'Reset App State' clears shopping cart and session state
Test Steps:
1. Add items to cart.
2. Open Burger Menu.
3. Click 'Reset App State'.
Expected Result: Shopping cart badge count is immediately cleared to 0 and application state resets.

Scenario / Description: Verify 'Logout' functionality clears session and redirects to Login page
Test Steps:
1. Open Burger Menu from any internal page.
2. Click 'Logout'.
Expected Result: User session is destroyed and user is redirected back to the primary Login page (/index.html).
